text.description_html:
First Impressions SD-SQDP/9-US32D 9 Inch Modern Square Stainless Steel Shower Door Pulls

Very modern designed 9" glass shower door pull made of 5/8" square solid stainless steel by First Impressions, a leader manufacture in door pulls. Warm Satin Stainless Steel finish for a truly eye catching modern appearance. They requiring little maintenance, designed to enhance any setting where a modern, clean look is desired.

Specifications for First Impressions SD-SQDP/9-US32D Modern Stainless Steel Shower Pulls

  • Total Length: 9"
  • Mounting Centers: 6" C/C (distance between the 2 mounting holes)
  • Projection: 2-1/8"
  • Diameter: 5/8" Square
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel

Note: These modern stainless steel shower door pulls are handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths up to 6 feet. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged with 2 door pull handles and includes the hardware for back to back mounting on 1/4" to 1/2" thick glass shower doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls)
